Can't reproduce the bug, maybe only happens on Nvidia GPU's.

Godot v4.5.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 580 2048SP (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 31.0.21923.11000) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.91 GiB memory

Can reproduce this bug, using nvidia GPU.

Godot v4.5.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8129) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-9600K CPU @ 3.70GHz (6 threads) - 15.92 GiB memory

I'm curious if it's related to driver version

Can you still reproduce this issue in 4.6.stable or later?

Note that on Windows, 4.6 defaults to D3D12 for Forward+. It would be worth checking both the D3D12 and Vulkan drivers to confirm whether the issue is fixed.

It still crashes using Vulkan, but with D3D12 I get an error instead (which is probably expected):
